g.text: Rhubarb mouth chart for Dot (A–H plus X). Exact geometry is in mouth-visemes.dot.json.
Mouth width unit = 100 (0.30 × head width). Corners stay within ±6 units of each other, except E and F. The jaw value is how far the chin drops, as a fraction of mouth width.
B K S T EE (clenched teeth)
G F V (teeth on lower lip)
Mapping from the current repo variants:
closed → A teeth → B open → C
smirk, snarl, frown and grin stay as
EMOTION mouths for holds. They are
not visemes and never come from Rhubarb.
